## POST `/api/instances/fastVP/{id}/action/modify`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Modify System FAST VP settings. Please note, once Relocation Rate is changed, it will take certain time up to the next scheduled relocation to update estimated relocation time.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | yes | Unique instance id. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `relocationRate` | `FastVPRelocationRateEnum` | Possible FAST VP relocation rates. \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|High\|1\|High relocation rate.\| \|Medium\|2\|Medium relocation rate.\| \|Low\|3\|Low relocation rate.\|… |
| `isScheduleEnabled` | boolean | Enable system relocation schedule. |
| `scheduleDays` | array of `DayOfWeekEnum` | List of days of the week on which to run scheduled relocations. |
| `scheduleStartTime` | string (interval - h+:mm:ss[.sss]) | Time of day to start scheduled relocations. Maximum resolution is in minutes. |
| `scheduleEndTime` | string (interval - h+:mm:ss[.sss]) | Time of day at which scheduled relocation should end. Maximum resolution is in minutes. |
| `isPaused` | boolean | Pause/Resume data relocation. |

**Responses:** `204` No Content
